stories.title: At least 17 people killed in 2 mass shootings on the same day in South Africa
stories.description: JOHANNESBURG (AP) — At least 17 people were killed in two mass shootings on the same day in South Africa. Motives have not been immediately established for the crimes some 530 kilometers (330 miles) apart, police said Monday.
